checked_claims.note: Verified by Riemann-Roch and the Casnati-Ekedahl degree formula deg W_5 = 16, deg omega_C = 10, thus deg L = 6, chi(L) = 1, and h^0(L) >= 1.

Verified that deg(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) = -4, so the f=4 obstruction component always vanishes, while the f=5 component deg(omega_C tensor W_5^vee(Gamma)) = 0 has a nonzero section iff the bundle is trivial, i.e., O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L.
Since the evaluation-failure locus and the Abel-Jacobi incidence locus agree on geometric points, their reduced induced substacks are isomorphic.
Verified that ordering six distinct points forms a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open of the effective-divisor relative linear system.

finding_candidates.evidence: For g=6 and f_1=4, the Casnati-Ekedahl degree formula gives deg W_4 = 20. For any divisor \Gamma of degree 6, deg(\omega_C \otimes W_4^\vee(\Gamma)) = 10 - 20 + 6 = -4. Since this is strictly negative, the global section space vanishes on all fibres.
finding_candidates.statement: On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover C -> P^1 with balanced splitting F = O(4) ⊕ O(5), the f=4 component of the CE evaluation obstruction bundle \omega_C \otimes W_4^\vee(\Gamma) has degree -4 for any degree-six divisor \Gamma, hence H^0(\omega_C \otimes W_4^\vee(\Gamma)) = 0 and the obstruction vanishes identically on this component.
finding_candidates.title: Vanishing of f=4 CE obstruction component on genus-6 curves

finding_candidates.evidence: For g=6 and f_2=5, the Casnati-Ekedahl degree formula gives deg W_5 = 16. For any divisor \Gamma of degree 6, deg(\omega_C \otimes W_5^\vee(\Gamma)) = 10 - 16 + 6 = 0. A degree-zero line bundle has a nonzero section if and only if it is trivial, which translates directly to the line bundle isomorphism O_C(\Gamma) \cong L.
finding_candidates.statement: On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover C -> P^1 with balanced splitting F = O(4) ⊕ O(5), the f=5 component of the CE evaluation obstruction bundle \omega_C \otimes W_5^\vee(\Gamma) has degree 0 for any degree-six divisor \Gamma. Consequently, evaluation fails on \Gamma if and only if O_C(\Gamma) is isomorphic to L = W_5 \otimes \omega_C^{-1}.
finding_candidates.title: Evaluation failure condition for f=5 CE component

finding_candidates.evidence: Since the points in the configuration space are pairwise distinct, the action of the symmetric group S_6 is free. Étale-locally, a reduced divisor of degree 6 splits into 6 disjoint sections, proving the etale torsor property over the open reduced-support locus.
finding_candidates.statement: The forgetful map from the relative ordered distinct configuration stack Conf_6(C/B^{bal}) to the relative effective-divisor space of degree six is a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open locus.
finding_candidates.title: S_6 ordering torsor over reduced-support open relative divisor space

proof_dependency_checks.note: We confirmed that step-by-step, the evaluation-failure locus is correctly identified on smooth genus-6 degree-four covers with balanced Casnati–Ekedahl splitting. In particular: (1) deg W_5 = 16 and deg L = 6, yielding chi(L) = 1 and h^0(L) >= 1; (2) Serre duality and f=4 obstruction vanishing show evaluation fails iff O_C(p_1 + ... + p_6) is isomorphic to L; (3) because the sections are pairwise-distinct, the ordering map to the relative divisor space is a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open.

strongest_attack: The strongest potential attack targets the stabilizer/multiplicity behavior of the evaluation-failure locus. If one incorrectly asserts that the evaluation-failure scheme Z and the Abel-Jacobi incidence scheme I are isomorphic as nonreduced schemes, the proof would fail because the jump in the dimension of the f=5 obstruction space could introduce unexpected nilpotent/Fitting ideal behavior. Furthermore, if one tries to formulate this torsor on coarse moduli spaces rather than stacks, the S_6-torsor would branch over curves with non-trivial automorphisms. The proof successfully avoids both pitfalls by working strictly stack-theoretically and restricting the isomorphism to the reduced induced substacks (Z_red = I_red).
theorem_statement: Let B^{bal} be the moduli stack of smooth genus-6 degree-four covers gamma:C→P^1 equipped with balanced Casnati–Ekedahl splitting F=O_{P^1}(4)⊕O_{P^1}(5), and put W_5=(O_{P(E^∨)}(2)⊗gamma^*O_{P^1}(-5))|_C and L=W_5⊗omega_C^{-1}. On Conf_6(C/B^{bal}), the stack of six ordered pairwise-distinct sections, the reduced evaluation-failure locus Z_red is exactly the reduced Abel–Jacobi incidence locus defined by O_C(p_1+⋯+p_6)≅L. Its quotient by S_6 is the reduced-support open in the relative effective-divisor incidence space for L, and Z_red→Z_red/S_6 is a finite étale S_6-torsor. Fibrewise deg L=6, chi(L)=1, and h^0(L)≥1.
